STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit & holding_box) -> u3
(u0, at_exit & !holding_box) -> u2
(u0, box_fell & !at_exit) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, at_exit & holding_box) -> u3
(u1, holding_box & !at_exit) -> u0
(u1, !holding_box & !box_fell) -> u2
(u1, else) -> u1
(u2, else) -> u2
(u3, else) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit & holding_box, u3) -> 1.0
(u0, at_exit & !holding_box, u2) -> -0.5
(u1, at_exit & holding_box, u3) -> 1.0
(u1, holding_box & !at_exit, u0) -> 0.2
(u1, !holding_box & !box_fell, u2) -> -0.5
feedback: The RM faithfully encodes both clauses of the task. u1 is entered only via (u0, box_fell & !at_exit) with no reward, which is correct since the fall is exogenous and unforced; from u1, holding_box on the very next step necessarily means the pickup action fired (hands were emptied by the fall, and only pickup refills them), so (u1, holding_box & !at_exit) -> u0 with +0.2 is exactly the 'very next move picks it up' check, while (u1, !holding_box & !box_fell) -> u2 with -0.5 is the explicit, unrecoverable regression for a missed pickup. Clause (b) is enforced on every path: (u0, at_exit & holding_box) -> u3 (+1.0) versus (u0, at_exit & !holding_box) -> u2 (-0.5), and the exit-without-box case from u1 is caught by its !holding_box guard into the same penalized absorbing u2. FINAL_STATES is present and nonempty; u3 is declared and is the accepting success state (exit with box and no prior missed pickup, since any violation would have diverted to u2). Guards within u0 and u1 are mutually exclusive and jointly exhaustive: the else self-loops absorb the constraint-impossible combinations and all irrelevant propositions (siren_ringing, switch_toggled), so the machine is total and deterministic, and the event/persistent distinction is handled correctly (box_fell as a one-step event gate, holding_box/at_exit as conditions). Rewards are dense where the agent acts and bounded: at most 0.2 per fall-pickup (falls are exogenous and capped at two, so max 1.4 total with the exit reward) and a single -0.5 before absorption; drop/pickup shuffling in u0 earns nothing, so no reward farming is possible. Two harmless redundancies worth noting, neither affecting behavior: (u1, at_exit & holding_box) -> u3 and its 1.0 reward entry are unreachable, because a single step after a fall cannot both pick up the box and step onto the exit; and (u1, else) (a further box_fell with empty hands) can never fire, since a scheduled fall is never due on the step immediately after a fall (the second fall is scheduled 2-6 steps after the pickup that follows). Both are retained for formal transition coverage and are acceptable.

def siren_ringing(env): return env.siren_ringing
def switch_toggled(env): return "toggle" in env.events_this_step
def holding_box(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "box"
def box_fell(env): return "fall" in env.events_this_step
def at_exit(env): return env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]) is not None and env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]).type == "goal"
